text: Sulfur dioxide emissions from a thermal power station elevated air pollution indices in Chandrapur.
Untreated chemical effluents discharged into the river caused fish deaths in Ankleshwar.
Agricultural pesticide run-off contaminated groundwater in Bhatinda.
Heavy construction machinery created severe noise pollution in Gurgaon.
Burning of plastic waste released toxic gases in Faridabad.
Sewage discharge into coastal waters polluted sea near Mangalore.
Heavy diesel traffic increased nitrogen dioxide levels near Chennai port.
Sludge dumping near industrial area polluted soil with heavy metals in Tarapur.
Compressor stations at a gas facility created persistent industrial noise in Dibrugarh.
Open stubble burning degraded air quality and increased PM2.5 in Ludhiana.
